answer_1.quote: Question generation (QG) is a hot research topic that aims to create valid and fluent questions corresponding to the answers by fully understanding the semantics on a given text.

answer_2.quote: We adopted three standard evaluation metrics in the QG task, including BLEU-4, METEOR, and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We carried out human evaluations to analyze the generated results. To avoid biases, we randomly sampled 100 cases from the test set and generated questions for each test case by all the evaluated methods. We then invited eight students to give the binary rating on each question independently.
answer_4.guideline: The rating was in terms of three metrics, including valid syntax, relevance to input textual sentences, and logical rationality to the answer.
